subject: Invoice #1234 overdue
body:
Dear customer,

Our records show that invoice #1234 for $2,450.00, issued on October 1, is now 15 days overdue. Please arrange payment by November 30 to avoid a late fee of 2%. If you have already paid, kindly send us the remittance details.

Best regards,
Accounts Receivable

subject: Weekly engineering sync
body: Agenda: 1) status of the payments API migration to Node 22, 2) last Friday's database outage post-mortem, 3) on-call rotation for December. Please add your updates to the shared doc before Thursday 10:00. The meeting link stays the same.

subject: Company retreat announcement
body: We invite you to our annual company retreat in the Carpathians on June 12-14! Expect team-building workshops, hiking and a gala dinner. Please confirm your attendance with HR by May 1. We will also film short videos for our social media campaign, so feel free to bring your best smile.
